items.title: Italian unions take industrial action over Microsoft job cuts
items.summary: Italian unions Filcams Cgil, Fisascat Cisl and Uiltucs announced the action in Rome on 5 November 2026. It takes effect immediately and covers overtime, additional working hours and flexible working arrangements. The decision followed a national coordination meeting on 26 October and a national staff assembly on 30 October. items.title: Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims Report
items.summary: In the week ending November 7, the advance figure for seasonally adjusted initial claims was 200,000, an increase of 9,000 from the previous week's revised level. The previous week's level was revised up by 2,000 from 189,000 to 191,000. The 4-week moving average was 195,250, unchanged from the previous week's revised average. The previous week's average was revised up by 500 from 194,750 to 195,250.

items.title: Unifor wins Breaking Through Award for successfully organizing Amazon and care workers
items.summary: Unifor Canada received this year’s Breaking Through Award for organizing workers at an Amazon warehouse in British Columbia and in the country’s long-term care sector.
